title: Fluent 2: spatial continuity
summary: Teach when a container keeps its identity through resizing and why peer destinations need a different temporal relationship.
use_when: A workspace, document inspector or responsive pane needs to preserve object identity and real hierarchy.
avoid_when: Depth or travel would invent a relationship between peer destinations or distract from a flat comparison.
